lines.text: This is one human cell.
It is very small. About five cells like it fit across the width of one hair.
Let's open it. Inside are organelles: small parts, and each one has a job.
The cell membrane is the outer skin: a double layer of fat molecules that decides what goes in and out.
The nucleus holds the DNA. It is the recipe book for every protein the cell makes.
Pores in the nuclear envelope are gates. A copy of one instruction, messenger RNA, leaves through them.
A ribosome reads the messenger RNA and links amino acids, one at a time, into a new protein chain.
Many ribosomes sit on the rough ER. Their proteins go into its sheets and fold into shape.
The smooth ER has no ribosomes. It makes fats and stores calcium.
The Golgi apparatus finishes and sorts proteins. Vesicles bring them in on one side and carry them out to the membrane.
Mitochondria burn food with oxygen and store the energy as ATP, the fuel the cell runs on.
lines.speak: [Mitochondria](/mˌaɪtoʊkˈɑːndɹiə/) burn food with oxygen and store the energy as A-T-P, the fuel the cell runs on.

lines.text: Inside, the inner membrane is folded into cristae. The folds give more room to make ATP.
lines.speak: Inside, the inner membrane is folded into cristae. The folds give more room to make A-T-P.

lines.text: Lysosomes are small sacs full of acid and enzymes. They digest old parts and bacteria.
Peroxisomes break down fatty acids, and turn hydrogen peroxide into water and oxygen.
lines.speak: [Peroxisomes](/pəɹˈɑːksɪsˌoʊmz/) break down fatty acids, and turn hydrogen peroxide into water and oxygen.

lines.text: Next to the nucleus is the centrosome: two centrioles at right angles.
Microtubules grow out from it. Motor proteins carry cargo along them, like trains on a track.
Actin filaments form a mesh under the membrane. Intermediate filaments are tough cables that hold the cell together.
The real cell is far more packed than this, with billions of proteins in every corner.
Cells like this one join together to build tissues and organs.
An adult human body is made of about thirty trillion cells.
